structures.description: Large two-sided trading range covering most of the window: repeated bull legs (bars 17-22, 32-38) and bear legs (bars 6-10, 23, 54-65, 85-96) between 2357.18 and 2700.00 with heavy overlap and no sustained follow-through; most trade occurred below 2650.00.

Bull breakout attempt: bars 107-108 spiked above the bar 85 high of 2609.02 and bars 109-112 extended to a new window high 2700.00. The move is now being tested by the bars 113-118 pullback, which traded back below 2609.02 before bars 119-120 recovered it.
Bull swing from the bar 96 low 2370.54 to the bar 112 high 2700.00 (higher low versus bar 90's 2358.62), built from a series of higher closes with the bars 107-108 spike in its middle.
Post-spike consolidation / bull-flag band: bars 112-120 have held between 2568.16 and 2658.79 after the 2700.00 high, with the last two bars lifting back toward the upper part of the band.

Unconfirmed higher-high reversal candidate: bar 112 made a marginal new high 2700.00 after the bars 107-108 buy spike and the next six bars closed lower. Not confirmed, because bars 119-120 recovered 63.77 from the 2568.16 low and closed near their highs.

evidence_for: The window combines repeated strong legs in both directions (bull: bar 17, bars 107-108; bear: bar 23, bar 89) with long stretches of small overlapping bars (bars 24-31, 67-75, 92-100), the defining quality of a two-sided range.
Prior probes above 2600 were rejected: bar 65 spiked to 2680.00 and closed 2555.52; bar 85 spiked to 2609.02 and closed 2514.07.

After the new high 2700.00 (bar 112) price gave back 131.84 points in six bars to 2568.16, trading back below the 2609.02 breakout level, so breakout acceptance above the range top is not established.

The final close 2631.93 sits at the range's upper boundary (about 80% of the 2357.18-2700.00 band) and near the bars 107-108 breakout closes of 2578.60 and 2636.28, i.e. still at the top of the range rather than clear of it.
The lower boundary has been retested flat: 2357.18 (bar 10), 2358.62 (bar 90), 2370.54 (bar 96).
evidence_against: The recent leg is strongly directional: bars 96-112 rose 329.46 points with 12 of 16 closes higher, which is closer to a bull trend leg than to range rotation.
The breakout cleared every prior window high (2680.00 and 2609.02), so it is not merely an internal range probe.

The pullback low 2568.16 held above bar 84's 2544.63 high and above the bars 96-106 rise, and bars 119-120 closed at/near their highs, which also fits a bull flag inside a new leg rather than range continuation.
Window highs are rising (2537.57 bar 22, 2680.00 bar 65, 2700.00 bar 112) and lows since bar 90 are rising, an ascending structure that weakens the balanced-range reading.
transition_conditions: Bull acceptance: a close above 2658.79 (bar 114 high) that holds on the next pullback, followed by a close above 2700.00 with the bar closing in its upper third, would argue the breakout is being accepted and shift the read toward bull-trend.
Failed breakout: a close below 2568.16 (bar 118 low) would put price back under the bars 107-112 spike and back inside the bars 96-106 area, opening 2544.63 and then 2495.82 (bar 107 low).
Spike negation: a close below 2495.82 would negate the bars 107-112 spike and re-open the 2358-2410 lower boundary.
Continued overlap: alternating bull and bear bars with closes in the middle of the 2568.16-2700.00 band would keep the primary read as trading-range.
A second consecutive close below 2609.02 would confirm the 2700.00 high as another failed probe and favor a return toward the mid-2500s.
